description: This file defines the 'COD' payment method class for the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It includes logic to determine availability based on various cart and configuration conditions and provides method data for the payment options.

classes.name: COD
classes.description: Represents the Cash on Delivery payment method within the OpenCart system, extending the core model class and providing the 'getMethods' for determining available payment options.

methods.name: getMethods
methods.description: Determines available payment methods based on the customer's cart and address, returning an array of method data if applicable.
